title: Response to a Motion
what_it_is: The document that answers a filed motion - admitting, denying, or stating lack of knowledge as to each numbered allegation, and stating your own position on the relief requested.
who_reads_it: The judge or referee hearing the motion.
The moving party or their counsel, who is served a copy.
sequence: Read the motion's numbered facts and respond to each - an explicit admission, denial, or statement of lack of knowledge (which has the effect of a denial, MCR 2.111(C); MCR 2.111(E)(1)).
State your own position on the requested relief, and any counter-relief as a separate motion or counterclaim if applicable.
File and serve within the time set by the notice of hearing or MCR 2.119(C), whichever the court applies.
prepare: Your own chronology to check each alleged date and event against.
Any exhibit that directly rebuts a specific allegation - not a general rebuttal narrative.

applicable_rules.summary: A responsive pleading must state an explicit admission or denial of each allegation, plead no contest, or state a lack of knowledge.
An allegation not denied is deemed admitted, except as to damages.
Sets the response timing for a motion unless the court sets a different time.

traps.trap: Ignoring an allegation instead of denying it.
traps.safe_move: Silence has the effect of a denial for most allegations (MCR 2.111(E)(1)) - but confirm; do not assume for every allegation type.

traps.trap: Responding with argument instead of admit/deny.
traps.safe_move: Save argument for the brief; the response answers the facts first.

traps.trap: Missing the response deadline because it was calculated from the wrong anchor date.
traps.safe_move: Confirm whether the court set a different time than the default MCR 2.119(C) timeline; run the date through calculate_planning_date.

do_not: Never characterize the other parent with a clinical label as a pleaded claim (narcissist, alienator, PAS, coercive control) - GUARDRAILS.md S2.
Never use the child as a witness, messenger, interviewee, or source, and never record the child - GUARDRAILS.md S8, absolute.
Never assert that any recording you made is lawful - Michigan law is unsettled and the exposure is criminal.
Never sign or stipulate to anything on the spot without reading it fully first.

openers: Good morning/afternoon, Your Honor. My name is [Party], and I am representing myself.
I am here to address [narrow issue]. I have [N] exhibits and a short chronology.
closers: I don't have that information, but I can provide records if needed.
I'd like the record to reflect [narrow, factual point] and I reserve my right to address anything broader in the appropriate forum.

safety_gates: immediate danger -> 911, do not proceed on this guide alone
PPO/DV/CPS contact live -> stop, safety resources, do not proceed on this guide alone
UCCJEA/interstate fact -> stop, MC 416 affidavit guidance
recording question in any form -> unsettled law, criminal exposure, attorney question only
child asked/expected to speak to anyone about the case -> stop
exit_checklist: Every numbered allegation has an explicit admit/deny/no-knowledge response.
Counter-relief filed separately if needed, not buried in the response.
